sentences.text: A galaxy's oxygen abundance is how much oxygen its gas holds.
sentences.role: plain-language definition before any formal method

sentences.text: Stars forge that oxygen, so it grows as galaxies build stars.
This paper asks whether galaxies at redshift nine to ten had already reached nearby levels.
Answering is tricky, because gravitational lensing can distort galaxy masses, and the nearby benchmark is extrapolated.
sentences.role: why lensing and benchmark choices matter

sentences.text: So the paper uses five strictly unlensed galaxies, measured by the direct electron-temperature method.
The result: their oxygen sits near one fifth of the nearby benchmark.
In logarithmic units, that is zero point six nine dex lower.
sentences.role: optional dex form, after the plain form

sentences.text: The sample is small, and the absolute abundance scale stays uncertain.
This is not a formal statistical detection.
